_note: Batch 15: the eight home-page categories deepened in one file — Energy Healing, Sound & float, Natural & Alternative Therapies, Retreats & day escapes, Breathwork, Meditation classes, Dietitians & nutrition, Sleep & Recovery. Researched from public information on 10 Aug 2026. Original blurbs, all unclaimed, no copied ratings, no therapeutic claims: reiki/kinesiology/energy copy names modalities and formats only, never conditions; TCM/naturopath copy lists services, not condition menus; dietitian copy names their published practice areas since APDs are regulated clinicians, but promises no outcomes. The Retreats section repeats batch 14 unchanged so this file stands alone — the importer's dedupe makes that safe if 14 was already imported. Honest shortfalls rather than padding: Sound & float adds only 4 (the directory already lists every major Perth float centre — Beyond Rest, Float Lab, Salt Float, Clear Mind, Re-Boot); Energy 8; Meditation 8; Breathwork 9; Natural 7; Nutrition 7; Sleep & Recovery 6. Candidates dropped for failed verification: Biota in Harmony (conflicting suburbs), Lightbody Being (dead page), SingLisa (Victoria, not WA), Monad Centre (site unreachable), Ashcliffe (sleep program not on their site), Alchemy West Leederville (could not pin identity), Rainbow Sounds and The Wright Healing (no fixed suburb).

categories.name: Energy Healing
categories.blurb: Reiki, pranic and shamanic healing, chakra balancing, crystal and spiritual healing.

categories.name: Sound & float
categories.blurb: Sound baths, gong journeys, float tanks and sensory recovery rooms.

categories.name: Natural & Alternative Therapies
categories.blurb: Naturopaths, herbalists, homeopaths, Chinese medicine, Ayurveda and acupuncture.

categories.name: Retreats & day escapes
categories.blurb: Half-day resets through to weekend retreats within a drive of Perth.

categories.name: Breathwork
categories.blurb: Conscious connected breathing, pranayama and nervous-system reset work.

categories.name: Meditation classes
categories.blurb: Drop-in sittings, guided courses and beginner-friendly evening classes.

categories.name: Dietitians & nutrition
categories.blurb: Accredited practising dietitians and nutrition support, in clinic and by telehealth.

categories.name: Sleep & Recovery

listings.name: MINDTOSOUL Reiki
listings.blurb: Alex practises reiki from a quiet home studio in Wembley, with hands-on sessions in person and distant sessions for those further afield. Alongside the table work there's a mentoring thread — personal empowerment and spiritual development guidance — plus a free reiki guide for the curious and gift cards for someone else's first session.
listings._source: mindtosoul.com.au — practitioner name, Wembley studio address, in-person and distant formats confirmed; prices not published

listings.name: Life in Harmony WA
listings.blurb: Tracy King works as a reiki master and intuitive healer from an Ocean Reef practice in Perth's northern coastal suburbs, offering in-person energy healing sessions. A small, single-practitioner space rather than a clinic.
listings._source: lifeinharmonywa.com — practitioner name, Ocean Reef location and reiki master credential from their published pages; site was intermittently unreachable during checking, so details are search-level. Worth a manual eyeball

listings.name: Holistic Bliss
listings.blurb: Christie's home clinic in Booragoon mixes energetic kinesiology, Holy Fire and Karuna reiki, sound healing and ceremonial cacao, with monthly group healing sessions for up to ten. Open Tuesday to Thursday and Saturdays by appointment, with evening slots on request, plus reiki and Access Bars training through the year.
listings._source: holisticbliss.com.au — practitioner, Booragoon home clinic, service list, open days, group session capacity, phone and email confirmed; prices not published

listings.name: Jude Casey Kinesiology
listings.blurb: Jude Casey is a registered specialised kinesiologist working from North Fremantle, with a practice built entirely around muscle-monitoring balances across emotional, structural, nutritional and energetic streams. Booking runs online around the clock through Cliniko.
listings._source: judecaseykinesiology.com — practitioner name and registration, Foundry Court address, kinesiology streams, phone, email and Cliniko booking confirmed. Their per-system condition framings deliberately not repeated

listings.name: Kinesiology by Margaret
listings.blurb: Margaret practises kinesiology from Attadale, south of the river, with in-person balances at the Stoneham Road rooms and online sessions for those who can't get there. Appointments book directly through her online diary.
listings._source: kinesiologybymargaret.com — Attadale address and online booking from their published pages; search-level verification, details worth a manual check

listings.name: Energise Natural Health Clinics
listings.blurb: A multidisciplinary clinic in Kallaroo where Rachel Davies Burrows runs the kinesiology room alongside chiropractic, massage, naturopathy and reiki under the one roof. Kinesiology and breathwork sit side by side on the menu, patients thirteen and up, booked through Cliniko.
listings._source: energise-health.com.au — Kallaroo location, kinesiologist name, multidisciplinary service list, 13+ policy, phone and Cliniko booking confirmed; their condition list deliberately not repeated

listings.name: Sacred Balance Therapies
listings.blurb: Lily Mackay runs kinesiology and energy-work sessions entirely remotely from Perth — clients join online, lying down or sitting, while she works through muscle monitoring and energy balancing at a distance. Session packages and gift certificates book through her online diary.
listings._source: sacredbalancetherapies.com.au — practitioner name, remote-only format, booking system confirmed; prices not published

listings.name: Healing Divine
listings.blurb: Dr Priscilla Brockman brings an unusual combination to energy work — a medical practitioner who also practises as an energy therapist, offering reiki, crystal and energy therapy sessions from Nedlands. Sessions are hands-on table work with the client fully clothed.
listings._source: healingdivine.com — practitioner name and MD background, Nedlands location, reiki/crystal/energy services from their published pages; search-level verification, site is dated — worth a manual check before featuring

listings.name: Treemendus Health
listings.blurb: Andrew and Servane Cox run weekly sound healing and guided meditation evenings — gongs, Tibetan and crystal bowls, medicine drum and chimes — every Friday night in South Perth, with a second weekly session in Joondalup. Beyond the regulars there are monthly sound immersions in the Yanchep cave, accredited sound-healing training, one-to-one sound therapy and naturopathy.
listings.next: Sound healing & meditation · Friday nights, South Perth
listings._source: treemendushealth.com.au + academyofsoundhealing.com profile — operators, Friday South Perth sessions at the Citizens Centre, Joondalup weekly session, Yanchep cave events, training accreditation confirmed; prices not published

listings.name: Altered States Wellness
listings.blurb: A long-running float space in Willetton that has grown into a compact recovery studio: float tanks for full sensory rest, plus sauna, cold plunge and red light therapy. One of the few float options south-east of the river.
listings._source: alteredstateswellness.com + public directory listings — Gympie Way address, float/sauna/cold plunge/red light services confirmed; prices on their booking system

listings.name: Emerson Floatation Spa
listings.blurb: Kelmscott's float rooms sit inside a broader day-spa menu: floatation therapy alongside massage, infrared sauna and beauty treatments, making it easy to stack a float with table work in one visit. One of the only float options in the south-eastern corridor.
listings._source: Public directory and guide listings (their own site was unreachable during checking) — Kelmscott location, float + massage + infrared sauna menu; search-level verification, worth a manual check of the URL before publishing

listings.name: The Life Spring Float Tank Centre
listings.blurb: Three float cabins — roomier than the traditional pods — in the middle of Rockingham, serving the coastal strip south of Perth. The cabins' extra space makes floats less daunting for first-timers who baulk at an enclosed pod.
listings._source: Public guides and their Instagram (@floatrockingham) — Market Street address and three-cabin setup confirmed; no standalone website found, so the profile links their active Instagram

listings.name: Naturopath Life Wellness Centre
listings.blurb: Jarrod Cooper's city-centre naturopathy practice on St Georges Terrace, working across herbal medicine, homeopathy, nutrient therapy and diet and lifestyle consultation, with functional testing available where it's useful. Face-to-face or by phone and video, with a free ten-minute phone chat to see if it's the right fit.
listings._source: naturopathlife.com.au — practitioner, Terrace address, service list, free intro call and phone confirmed; their condition-focus list deliberately not repeated

listings.name: Perth Naturopath — Jackie Lowater
listings.blurb: Jackie Lowater has practised as a naturopath and homeopath for over twelve years from Kallaroo in Perth's northern suburbs, blending herbal and homeopathic prescribing with diet and lifestyle work in unhurried consultations.
listings._source: perthnaturopath.com.au — practitioner name, Kallaroo base, 12+ years in practice confirmed; her stated special interests are conditions and deliberately not repeated

listings.name: Gloria Cicchini Naturopathy
listings.blurb: Gloria Cicchini practises naturopathy from Hillarys with a heavy emphasis on testing — hair mineral analysis, DUTCH hormone panels, microbiome and genetic testing — feeding long-form 60–90 minute consultations. Booking runs through her online clinic diary.
listings._source: glorianaturopath.com.au — practitioner, Hillarys address, qualifications, testing menu and 60–90 min consult length confirmed; site honestly notes naturopathy isn't covered by private health insurers

listings.name: Ping Ming Health
listings.blurb: A Chinese medicine clinic in the Equus Arcade off Hay Street, open six days by appointment: acupuncture, Chinese herbal medicine, meridian massage, cupping and channel scrubbing, with telehealth for herbal consults. No GP referral needed and health-fund rebates apply.
listings._source: pingminghealth.com/perth — CBD address, Mon–Sat hours, service list, phone and rebate detail confirmed; their 30+ condition list deliberately not repeated

listings.name: Tao Acupuncture
listings.blurb: Qin Wang (Kathy) holds a bachelor, master and PhD in traditional Chinese medicine with over thirty years in clinic, practising Chinese and Japanese acupuncture, herbal medicine, cupping and moxibustion from Shenton Park rooms.
listings._source: taoacupuncture.com.au — practitioner name and TCM doctorate, Excelsior Street address, service list, 30+ years, phone and email confirmed; fertility/pain treatment framings deliberately not repeated

listings.name: B&Q Acupuncture
listings.blurb: Drs Benny Yang and Queenie Wu, both AHPRA-registered Chinese medicine practitioners with Chinese medical degrees, run this Subiaco clinic in the Salvado Road medical precinct — acupuncture, herbal medicine, cupping and channel scrubbing.
listings._source: bqacupuncture.com.au — both practitioners with AHPRA registration numbers, Salvado Road address, services and phone confirmed; women's-health condition list deliberately not repeated

listings.name: Yan Acupuncture
listings.blurb: An acupuncture and Chinese medicine practice on Churchill Avenue in Subiaco, in the same medical quarter as the hospital precinct, offering acupuncture and herbal consultations by appointment.
listings._source: Public directory listings — Churchill Avenue address confirmed; no website located, so contact fields left for the practice to claim and complete. Thinnest entry in this batch; drop before import if you'd rather not carry a listing without a site

listings.name: Hidden Valley Eco Lodges & Day Spa
listings.blurb: An adults-only retreat set in its own jarrah forest in the Perth Hills, about half an hour from the city. Self-contained lodges each have a kitchen, log fire and outdoor heated jacuzzi, and the on-site day spa — massage, facials, rituals and wraps, pregnancy pampering — takes casual day visitors as well as lodge guests, Monday to Saturday. In-lodge dining, platters and picnic hampers round out a stay.
listings._source: hiddenvalleyeco.com.au — address, adults-only policy, lodge features, day spa menu and Mon–Sat hours, day-visitor access, phone and email all published

listings.name: Amaroo Retreat & Spa
listings.blurb: Eight luxury chalets tucked into Perth Hills bushland at Mount Helena, each with a private spa on its deck. The day spa offers massage and facial treatments, and The Lounge restaurant and bar keeps a stay self-contained — breakfast hampers arrive at the chalet door. Accommodation is strictly adults-only; stays start from $495 a night.
listings._source: amarooretreat.com.au — address, eight chalets, private deck spas, day spa, restaurant, 18+ accommodation policy, from-$495 nightly rate, phone and email all published

listings.name: Natures Paradise Health Retreat
listings.blurb: A small, purpose-built adults-only retreat on a secluded hilltop outside Mundaring, surrounded by state forest and national park, running residential programs since 2013. Themed retreats span day visits through to multi-day stays — yoga, forest walks, mindfulness and spa-focused formats — with a swim pond, gym, infrared sauna, mineral baths and a library on the property. Airport pick-up is complimentary for retreat guests.
listings._source: naturesparadise.com.au — Mundaring hilltop location, adults-only, operating since 2013, retreat formats, facilities, airport pick-up, phone and email published; street address and package prices not shown. Their condition-themed retreat names deliberately not repeated in our copy

listings.name: Swan Valley Retreat
listings.blurb: A day spa and small overnight retreat in the Swan Valley with an unusually broad wellness menu: massage, facials, clay treatments, hydrotherapy and floatation therapy, plus The Oasis — sauna, ice bath and spa sessions. Day visitors are explicitly welcome, six days a week, with Oasis and float sessions running Sundays too. Three luxury rooms serve those who stay over.
listings._source: swanvalleyretreat.com.au — address, three rooms, spa/float/hydrotherapy menu, The Oasis, day-visitor policy and weekly hours, phone published; prices on the Fresha booking system rather than the site

listings.name: Brookleigh Day Spa Health Retreats
listings.address: 1235 Great Northern Highway, Upper Swan WA
listings.blurb: Structured retreat packages in the Swan Valley, from single-day resets built around yoga, meditation and spa treatments through to multi-day residential programs. Day formats start at $395, the one-day yoga and meditation retreat runs at $525 with group rates, and longer packages extend to five days. Retreats run Monday to Friday, booked online.
listings._source: brookleighbeautyandspa.com.au — Upper Swan address via booking system, package names, day and multi-day prices, Mon–Fri availability, Fresha booking; package names like 'Health Revival' kept out of our copy

listings.name: Wyld Tribe
listings.blurb: A Perth women's community running retreats since 2012, best known for the Wild Woman Weekend — four days and three nights of ceremony, dance, workshops and singing in bushland at the foot of the Darling Scarp in Serpentine. Facilitators Tracy McFie and Larissa O'Neill have held the weekend for thirteen years. Fully catered with vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free options; $1,666 all-inclusive, alongside mentoring and smaller gatherings through the year.
listings._source: wyldtribe.com — facilitator names, 13-year history, 2012 founding, Serpentine venue, 4-day/3-night format, catering detail, $1,666 price, Sep 2026 dates and contact email all published

listings.name: Journeys of the Spirit
listings.blurb: Julie Baker and Emma McLarty run small-group wellness journeys from Perth, with their signature Rejuvenation Retreat held on an 1,800-acre property in the Chittering Valley surrounded by state forest above the Avon River. The long-weekend format pairs private cabins and all meals with guided bush walks and unhurried days built around rest. The pair also lead international journeys — Kerala, Bhutan, Japan among them — and arrange private group retreats.
listings._source: journeysofthespirit.com.au — facilitator names, Chittering Valley 1,800-acre venue, cabin/meals/bush-walk inclusions, Sep 2026 dates, phone and email published; prices held in a brochure PDF

listings.name: Spanda School Retreats
listings.blurb: Fremantle's Spanda School runs structured silent retreats built on non-dual meditation, gentle movement and rest — one-day sittings at the school itself, and three- and seven-day residentials at Donnelly Lakes near Pemberton. Two formats serve different depths of practice: a guided version for those newer to silence, and longer unguided sits for experienced meditators. Around a hundred students come through each year, some from interstate and overseas.
listings._source: spandaschool.com — Fremantle base, Donnelly Lakes venue, 1/3/7-day formats, two practice streams, ~100 students yearly, phone published

listings.name: WildFlower Yoga Collective
listings.blurb: Holly Dutton teaches yoga at City Beach and runs residential retreats in WA's south-west — most recently a four-day Margaret River weekend combining daily yoga, sauna and ice bath sessions, breathwork, meditation, bush walks and a cacao ceremony, fully catered. Shared and single rooms from $1,495. Private retreats for groups of six or more can be arranged at Rottnest, Yallingup, Ferguson Valley and the Swan Valley.
listings._source: wildfloweryogacollective.net — facilitator name and background, City Beach classes, Margaret River retreat inclusions and pricing, private retreat minimum and locations, email published

listings.name: BODHI J Wellness Spa Retreat
listings.blurb: A long-standing Wembley day spa built around multi-hour 'spa journey' packages — massage, facials, body therapies and healing treatments using organic Sodashi and Li'tya products, with sauna and light-therapy rooms on site. A team of around forty therapists runs six days a week, with late Thursday evenings. Pregnancy-safe rituals and men's treatments sit alongside the classic day-escape packages.
listings._source: bodhispa.com (403 to fetch; cross-checked via bestwellness.com.au and public directory pages) — Grantham St address, hours incl. late Thursday, treatment menu, ~40 therapists, organic product lines, phone published

listings.name: PranaLab
listings.blurb: Pranayama-based breathwork built around the traditional understanding of breath as life force: studio group classes, private one-to-one sessions at your home or chosen spot, and private group sessions for couples or friends. A guided audio library — The Breath Within — keeps the practice going between sessions.
listings._source: pranalab.com.au — pranayama focus, class and private formats, audio library confirmed; operator name, suburb and prices not published on the site

listings.name: School of Breath
listings.blurb: Meg facilitates guided breathing practices across Perth studios — a regular Monday evening group class at Centre Space, hour-long private one-to-ones working through different breathing patterns and techniques, plus corporate workshops and retreats.
listings._source: schoolofbreath.com.au — facilitator, Monday 7:15pm Centre Space class, session formats, phone and email confirmed; prices via Fresha

listings.name: Breathwork with Shanie
listings.blurb: Ninety-minute breathwork sessions from Bayswater, in person or online — longer than a typical class, with room for the slow build, the peak and a proper wind-down in a single sitting.
listings._source: breathworkwithshanie.com.au — Bayswater base, 90-minute in-person/online format confirmed; prices not captured

listings.name: The Space Within Wellness
listings.blurb: Pranayama breathwork classes and guided meditation in Perth, with studio sessions and events running thirty to ninety minutes and one-on-one sessions shaped to the person. A small practice built on collaboration with other local facilitators.
listings._source: thespacewithinwellness.com.au — formats and session lengths, email confirmed; operator name, suburb and prices not published

listings.name: Paula Flinn Breathwork
listings.blurb: Paula Flinn holds conscious connected breathwork in a small Fremantle studio, deliberately kept intimate — group sessions cap at six people, on the first Friday evening of each month, alongside private one-to-one work.
listings.next: Group breathwork · first Friday evening monthly
listings._source: paulaflinnaustralia.com — Fremantle studio, conscious connected method, six-person cap and first-Friday cadence confirmed

listings.name: Somatic Breathwork Perth
listings.blurb: Somatic breathwork out of Fremantle in every format the practice comes in — group circles, private sessions, workshops and retreats — with the somatic emphasis on letting the body lead rather than the technique.
listings._source: Facebook page (their public presence) — Fremantle base and session formats; no standalone website found. Search-level verification

listings.name: Claire Belton Breathwork
listings.blurb: Claire Belton runs breathwork and shamanic breathwork practitioner trainings from Fremantle — regular courses locally and around Australia — for those who want to move from receiving sessions to facilitating them.
listings._source: clairebelton.com.au — Fremantle base, training focus, national course schedule confirmed

listings.name: Breathe 9D
listings.blurb: Immersive 9D breathwork journeys in Perth — conscious breathing set against layered psychoacoustic sound, live shamanic vocals and chants, across twelve themed journey formats. Sessions book through Eventbrite.
listings._source: breathe9d.com.au — twelve journey formats, phone and Eventbrite booking confirmed; facilitator name and venue suburb not published. Their trauma-themed journey titles deliberately not repeated

listings.name: Asana Breathwork
listings.blurb: João Soares pairs breathwork with registered counselling — an ACA-registered counsellor and somatic therapist running 9D breathwork sessions, fortnightly group workshops, one-to-one work and a 100-hour IPHM-accredited practitioner training from Southern River.
listings._source: asanabreathwork.com — practitioner name, ACA registration, Southern River base, session formats, training accreditation and email confirmed

listings.name: Zen Group of Western Australia
listings.address: St Paul's Anglican Church Hall, 162 Hampton Road, Beaconsfield WA 6162
listings.blurb: A lay Zen community in the Diamond Sangha lineage, sitting zazen every Thursday evening at the Beaconsfield church hall since its founding in 1982 — newcomers arrive at six for orientation. Teachers Mari Rhydwen Roshi and Glenn Wallis Roshi guide the practice, with monthly sits on country, quarterly intensive sitting days and an annual multi-day sesshin. Runs on dana; mats and chairs provided.
listings._source: zgwa.org.au — venue address, Thursday 6:30–8:30pm schedule, teachers, 1982 founding, retreat cadence and email all published; donation-based

listings.name: Diamond Way Buddhist Centre Perth
listings.blurb: Guided meditation in the Karma Kagyu tradition three times a week at Bibra Lake — Monday and Wednesday evenings and Sunday afternoons — each session opening with a short talk before twenty to thirty minutes of guided practice in English. Free to attend, donations voluntary, no experience needed; cushions and chairs provided.
listings._source: diamondway.org.au — Prout Way address, full weekly schedule, free/donation model, phone and email all published

listings.name: Perth Sri Chinmoy Centre
listings.blurb: Free meditation classes and workshops across Perth — Inglewood, Mount Claremont and Belmont among the venues — run continuously as a community service in the Sri Chinmoy tradition, with the Perth centre re-established in 1995. Classes are pitched at beginners, working from quietening the mind toward heart-centred meditation. Always free of charge.
listings._source: meditationperth.org + au.srichinmoycentre.org — free-of-charge model, venue suburbs, 1995 re-establishment confirmed

listings.name: Transcendental Meditation Perth
listings.blurb: Perth's TM centre in Subiaco, where certified teachers Karen Warner and Derek D'Cruz teach the standard Transcendental Meditation course — personalised instruction in the twice-daily twenty-minute technique, preceded by free information sessions in person or online. Course fees are income-based.
listings._source: tm.org.au/centre/perth — Hay Street Subiaco address, both teacher names, income-based fee model, phone and intro-session schedule published

listings.name: Body Mind Yoga Perth — MBSR
listings.address: South Perth Senior Citizens Centre, 53 Coode Street, South Perth WA
listings.blurb: Quentin Albertsen, trained through the Mindfulness Training Institute Australasia, teaches the classic eight-week Mindfulness-Based Stress Reduction course in South Perth: weekly 2.5-hour group sessions, a full-day retreat, guided audio for the 30–40 minutes of daily home practice, and a course book — $550 all in.
listings._source: bodymindyogaperth.com.au/mindfulness — teacher, training body, venue, course structure, $550 fee, phone and email all published

listings.name: Vedic Meditation Perth
listings.blurb: Dr Lana Loxton teaches Vedic Meditation in Perth — a personal mantra practised silently for twenty minutes twice a day, taught as deliberately effortless: no concentration, no forcing focus. Free weekly group meditations and regular free intro talks make it easy to look before committing to the course, with advanced classes, mentoring and retreats beyond it.
listings._source: vedicmeditationperth.com.au — teacher name, technique format, free intro and weekly group offerings, email confirmed; course suburb and prices not published

listings.name: Perth Meditation
listings.blurb: A dedicated meditation centre in Bicton running live guided classes morning to evening six days a week, in person and online, built around a simple seven-step method pitched at every age and experience level. Kids' classes run Tuesday evenings, membership includes unlimited daily classes, and a free one-on-one consultation starts things off.
listings._source: perthmeditation.net — Fifth Street Bicton address, six-day schedule with hours, kids classes, membership model, phone and email all published

listings.name: Soul Shakha
listings.blurb: Krista teaches Vedic Meditation across Perth, Margaret River and Busselton — a four-day beginner's course preceded by a free intro talk, then weekly group meditations to keep the practice honest, with kids' programs, corporate training and retreats alongside. She came to teaching after fifteen years in WA mining and trained in the Himalayan foothills in 2020.
listings._source: soulshakha.com.au — teacher background, 2020 teacher training, Perth/Margaret River/Busselton locations, course format confirmed; prices not published

listings.name: Nutrition IQ
listings.address: Suite 16, 44 Kings Park Road, West Perth WA 6005
listings.blurb: A small West Perth clinic led by Dr Nicola Lowth, dietitian and clinical nutritionist, joined by APD Paul Bailey with a sports nutrition background. The practice leans on formal testing — metabolism, hormones and gut microbiome — to drive individualised nutrition plans, with practice areas spanning metabolic health, sports nutrition, pre- and post-natal nutrition and disordered eating support.
listings._source: nutritioniq.com.au — both practitioners and credentials, Kings Park Road address, testing approach, practice areas, phone and email all published

listings.name: Dietetic Gut Clinic
listings.address: Hollywood Consulting Centre, Suite 312, 91 Monash Avenue, Nedlands WA 6009
listings.blurb: Ele Stojanoska practises as a gastrointestinal dietitian across rooms in Nedlands and Murdoch, FODMAP-certified and working exclusively in gut-focused medical nutrition therapy alongside the gastroenterology practices she consults from. Telehealth available.
listings._source: dieteticgutclinic.com — practitioner, three consulting locations with addresses, FODMAP certification, Dietitians Australia affiliation, phones and email published

listings.name: Katie Lenhoff Nutrition
listings.blurb: Senior APDs Katie Lenhoff and Louise Mousli consult from Leederville and Palmyra, bringing hospital-grade experience — renal, cardiology and respiratory dietetics between them — into private practice across kidney and heart health, diabetes, gut health and nutrition through the life stages. Medicare rebates apply with a GP plan; NDIS provider; virtual and in-person appointments.
listings._source: klnutrition.com.au — both practitioners and hospital backgrounds, Leederville and Palmyra addresses, Medicare/NDIS detail, phone and email published

listings.name: PDC Health Hub Dietitians
listings.address: 968b Albany Highway, East Victoria Park WA 6101
listings.blurb: Three accredited practising dietitians — Caitlin Parker (also a credentialled diabetes educator), Christie Lee and Lisa Goldsworthy — consult inside this Albany Highway allied-health clinic, alongside exercise physiology, physiotherapy and podiatry. Open six days with Sunday by appointment.
listings._source: pdchealthhub.com.au — all three dietitians named with credentials, address, hours, phone and email published

listings.name: Essence of Eating
listings.blurb: Jessica Ruescher, an accredited practising dietitian with more than fifteen years in practice, consults from Fremantle with a deliberately kind, non-judgemental style — evidence-based nutrition support across weight, gut health, diabetes and cholesterol.
listings._source: Public listing and their published profile — APD credential, 15+ years, Fremantle base; search-level verification, URL worth a manual check before publishing

listings.name: Hardy Nutrition
listings.blurb: Megan Hardy directs this multi-location Perth dietetic practice, offering evidence-based, personalised nutrition consultations across weight management, chronic disease, gut health and women's health.
listings._source: Their published practice profile — director name, multi-location model, practice areas; search-level verification, URL worth a manual check before publishing

listings.name: KIN Nutrition
listings.blurb: Elleisha Parish practises as a clinical nutritionist from Perth, consulting online Australia-wide with a focus on gut health, women's hormones and everyday energy — a telehealth-first practice rather than a clinic room.
listings._source: motherandkin.au — practitioner name, Perth base, online-first clinical nutrition model confirmed

listings.name: Reform & Restore Studio
listings.blurb: A Scarborough studio pairing small-group reformer Pilates — six reformers, never more — with a proper recovery wing: full-spectrum infrared sauna, commercial ice baths and structured contrast therapy. A $59 two-week unlimited intro pass covers the Pilates side.
listings._source: reformandrestorestudio.com.au — Scarborough Beach Road address, equipment detail, $59 intro pass, email confirmed

listings.name: Modern Ritual Yoga — Contrast Recovery
listings.blurb: A private infrared sauna and ice bath room inside Maylands' Modern Ritual yoga studio — booked as your own space rather than a shared facility, open around the class timetable seven days a week. The pairing makes a yoga-plus-contrast session a single stop.
listings._source: modernritualyoga.com — Ferguson Street address, private sauna/ice bath room, seven-day access around classes, phone and email confirmed

listings.name: Recovery Haus
listings.blurb: One of Perth's most fully-equipped recovery centres, open 6am to 10pm on weekdays: cryotherapy, hyperbaric oxygen, infrared sauna, contrast therapy, an LED light bed, compression, dry flotation, IV therapy and more, with a booking app and group and corporate sessions.
listings._source: recoveryhaus.com.au — Innaloo address, full equipment list, 6am–10pm weekday hours, phone and email published; prices in their booking system

listings.name: A Resolution Psychology — Sleep Therapy
listings.blurb: A community psychology practice in Applecross whose sleep therapy stream runs on cognitive behavioural therapy for insomnia: in-depth assessment to untangle sleep from everything else, then structured CBT-I work — sleep restriction, light-exposure strategies, worksheets — across anywhere from two to twenty sessions, finishing with relapse-prevention planning.
listings._source: aresolution.com.au/sleep-therapy — Applecross location, CBT-I program structure, 2–20 session range, phone and email published

listings.name: Vitality House
listings.blurb: A West Leederville wellness house running three infrared saunas alongside ice baths and steam showers — part of the cluster of recovery spaces that has grown up around Leederville in the last few years.
